headline: Iran Escalates Regional Tensions With Massive Missile Drills and Threats
subheadline: Iran launched at least 30 ballistic and hypersonic missiles plus Shahed drones from three provinces in its largest IRGC exercise since February.
lede: Iran conducted its largest military exercise since February, launching at least 30 ballistic and hypersonic missiles plus Shahed drones from Yazd, Isfahan, and Kermanshah while explicitly threatening ground incursions into neighboring states, attacks on Saudi oil facilities, and strikes on US naval assets. A Hezbollah cluster munition struck Israel's Ramim Ridge, causing 12 casualties including one critical and three serious injuries, with preliminary findings indicating a student brought an ammunition item that detonated. The Saudi coalition intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh as Qatar and Etihad suspended flights to major Saudi cities, and a crude tanker was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.

sections.title: Russian Strikes Target Ukrainian Infrastructure
sections.body: Russian forces launched coordinated drone and missile attacks across Ukraine overnight, hitting energy infrastructure and residential buildings in Kharkiv, Kyiv, and other regions. Ukraine's parliament is revising mobilization reservation rules, reducing deferments for defense and energy sectors from 100% to 85% and heat/water services from 75% to 60%. A recruitment center officer in Kharkiv pushed a 74-year-old woman, causing fractures, and fled without providing assistance or calling an ambulance. Ukraine is set to receive approximately €3 billion in additional EU military aid following discussions between Zelenskyy and European Commission President von der Leyen.

sections.title: Iranian Missiles and Threats Fuel Gulf Crisis
sections.body: Iran launched at least 30 ballistic and hypersonic missiles plus Shahed-136 and Shahed-238 drones from Yazd, Isfahan, and Kermanshah in its largest IRGC exercise since February, testing Kheibar Shekan and Emad missiles near Isfahan's Sofeh mountain. Iran warned regional states its armed forces may launch ground incursions into neighboring countries if war breaks out, threatened Saudi oil facilities with increased Houthi attacks, and planned attacks on US forces including sinking Navy ships in West Asia. A Hezbollah cluster bomb exploded at Israel's Ramim Ridge, wounding 12 people including one in critical condition, three serious, and one moderate, after a student reportedly brought an ammunition item to the site. Saudi coalition forces destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile fired toward Riyadh, while Qatar Airways and Etihad Airways suspended flights to Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam amid heightened threats.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Iran's unprecedented missile exercise combined with explicit threats of ground incursions into neighbors, attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure, and targeting of US naval assets signals a dramatic escalation in deterrence posture. The Ramim Ridge cluster munition attack demonstrates Hezbollah's capability and willingness to strike deeper into Israeli territory with area-effect weapons. Simultaneous Houthi missile fire on Riyadh and a tanker strike in the Strait of Hormuz indicate coordinated multi-axis pressure on Gulf energy security.
